summary: Update 2efbdfc changes when a learner logs DIFF-synced proposals relative to its NEWLEADER ACK, so the model had to change (MODEL_CHANGE_REQUIRED). The reference, MC, Trace and new Update.tla were revised, and four inherited abstraction defects were repaired. The prior harness was rebased and fresh traces were collected from the 4 earlier scenarios plus the update's DIFFSyncConsistencyTest; all 5 pass real TLC trace validation, and 4 deliberately corrupted traces are rejected. Standard MC and base checks found no violation up to the inherited level-23 bound. The update checks found a CommittedQuorumDurable violation, also in the full model: the learner only queues the proposals before sending the NEWLEADER ACK and does not wait for fsync, so the leader can commit and serve a transaction that only it has durably stored. A follow-on search found CommittedNeverLostByLeader violated as a result. MC-1 was reproduced on the updated code (the next leader is missing a transaction clients already read, after the acking learners crash before fsync), and the old revision has the same defect. Two new defects from code review were also reproduced: CR-2, where a learner that fails between NEWLEADER and UPTODATE is never shut down and leaks its processor threads, and CR-3, where a proposal ACK is taken as the NEWLEADER ACK and the learner is not counted. Campaigns that ran out of time are recorded as LIMITED_COVERAGE.
